_comment: English bodies for letta (framework). Mechanism per C0-1..6. No extraSections in source; sections/sectionTitles omitted. layer_position/providers not rendered — not included.

axes.model_access: Various models connect via a provider layer (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/local etc., per the official docs, not itemized one by one); its core narrative is the **stateful agent**: memory tiers (core/archival) edited and managed by the agent itself (the MemGPT paper line).
axes.runtime: **An agent-server form** (unlike a pure library): run a resident service (letta server); agents and memory persist inside the server; SDK/CLI connect to it. GitHub 25,216★, last push 2026-10-18 (API verified).
axes.local_files: The self-hosted server keeps agent state and memory in your database (SQLite by default, Postgres configurable) — data on your side; the Letta Cloud hosted line is a separate product surface.
axes.background: **The server form carries residency semantics by itself** — the structural difference from the other framework entries: the agent is a persistent entity, sessions can be interrupted and resumed (the official core narrative).
axes.tools: Tool/function calling + built-in file-read/write tool lines; MCP support status not itemized (the official docs have related lines, details unchecked).
axes.context: **Memory management is the product itself**: the core memory (agent self-edited) + archival (external retrieval store) tiering is the MemGPT design — cross-session memory is its default surface, not an add-on.
axes.permissions: The server has an authentication configuration surface (details not itemized); tool execution (file/command kinds) happens in the server environment — the self-hosted machine's permission surface must be defended by you.
axes.fit: Fits: agents needing a "persistent persona" (long-term memory + state resumption), self-hosted agent servers, the MemGPT design route. Does not fit: stateless one-shot calls (the server form is a cost); wanting only a library, not a service (a form-factor choice).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md).
